purpose: Authoritative implementation sequence, phase gates, deliverables, and validation criteria for building V4SH.

authority.rule: Build in phase order. Do not skip a validation gate merely to reach later UI or payment work faster.

implementation_strategy.principle: Build the smallest verifiable system first, then expand.
implementation_strategy.primary_loop: Implement -> build -> test -> inspect on real device -> fix -> validate -> continue.
implementation_strategy.design_rule: Use the approved Stitch screens as visual references while implementing native Android Compose screens.

phases.name: Spec and Feasibility Lock
phases.goal: Ensure the project has one authoritative product, design, navigation, security, payment, and architecture contract.
deliverables: All MCP specification JSON files present.
phases.gate: Do not begin broad implementation until all source-of-truth specifications are available and internally referenced.

phases.name: Android Foundation
phases.goal: Establish a clean native Android foundation matching the architecture specification.
validation: Gradle build succeeds.
App launches on the Redmi Note 13 Pro+ test device.
No architecture-boundary violations.
phases.gate: Only continue when the app launches reliably on the physical test device.

phases.name: UI and Navigation
phases.goal: Implement the frozen screen catalog and navigation contract without payment automation.
validation: All screen IDs in screens.json have an implementation target.
Navigation matches navigation.json.
Bottom navigation remains HOME | TRANSACTIONS | RECEIVE | PROFILE.
Warm Editorial design system is visually respected.
No unapproved screens or features are introduced.
phases.gate: Complete navigation and visual audit before integrating the payment engine.

phases.name: QR and Recipient System
phases.goal: Build QR scanning and recipient preparation without initiating payment.
validation: Standard supported UPI QR can be scanned.
Invalid/unsupported/missing QR data reaches the correct pre-initiation error state.
Scanning never initiates a payment.
Camera permission failure reaches the correct state.
phases.gate: QR flow must work end-to-end up to Review Payment without touching the payment engine.

phases.name: Payment Engine Prototype
phases.goal: Integrate the proven USSD/accessibility mechanism behind a controlled PaymentEngine interface.
validation: *99# detection works.
INITIAL_MENU is correctly classified.
Send Money is correctly selected.
UPI ID method is correctly selected.
UPI ID input is handled safely.
PIN_OR_SENSITIVE causes automation to stop.
Unknown/non-actionable screens cause automation to stop.
No arbitrary editable field receives payment input.
phases.gate: Do not call the payment prototype production-ready until real-device behavior is repeatable.

phases.name: Real Payment Integration
phases.goal: Connect the QR/review flow to the PaymentEngine while preserving the frozen payment semantics.
validation: SUCCESS only occurs on definitive confirmation.
FAILED only occurs on definitive failure.
UNKNOWN does not offer immediate retry.
Stop waiting does not claim to cancel an initiated transaction.
Network loss after initiation does not automatically become FAILED/CANCELLED.
phases.gate: Payment-state truth must pass safety tests before transaction persistence is considered complete.

phases.name: Transactions and Receive
phases.goal: Complete local transaction records and receiving-money surfaces.
validation: Only real V4SH payment records are stored.
No fabricated reference IDs.
History is clearly presented as a V4SH/local record.
Receive flow does not imply a V4SH wallet.
phases.gate: Transaction persistence must match payment truth exactly.

phases.name: Festival Reliability
phases.goal: Make the app resilient to the conditions expected at a crowded college festival.
deliverables: Safe handling of app background/foreground transitions.
validation: No network before initiation is non-destructive.
Network loss after initiation does not cause unsafe automatic retry.
Selected payment SIM remains consistent.
Payment access readiness is truthful.
Processing state cannot accidentally trigger duplicate payment.
phases.gate: Run reliability tests on the physical device under degraded conditions.

phases.name: Security and Privacy Hardening
phases.goal: Verify that implementation obeys security.json rather than merely displaying security copy.
validation: No UPI PIN enters app state.
No OTP enters app state.
No sensitive credentials are logged or stored.
Automation stops on sensitive screens.
Only required permissions are requested.
Privacy/security claims match actual behavior.
phases.gate: No release candidate until security validation passes.

phases.name: Real Device Validation
phases.goal: Validate the complete product on the physical Redmi Note 13 Pro+ test device and target network conditions.
validation: Build installs cleanly.
Critical flows are repeatable.
No crash in the primary payment journey.
No unsafe duplicate-payment path.
Visual audit passes against the approved Stitch references.
phases.gate: Only after this gate should the project be treated as demo-ready.

phases.name: Final Product and Demo
phases.goal: Prepare a stable festival-demo build and presentation narrative.
deliverables: Seeded/realistic local transaction presentation where appropriate.
validation: Demo follows the actual implemented behavior.
No feature is presented as supported when it is not implemented.
Known limitations are explicitly documented.

hard_gates.condition: App builds and launches on the physical device.
Frozen screen catalog and navigation are implemented without scope drift.
QR flow reaches Review Payment without initiating payment.
PaymentEngine prototype safely handles the proven USSD flow and stops at sensitive screens.
Payment outcome semantics pass SUCCESS/FAILED/UNKNOWN/CANCELLED safety validation.
Complete critical flow passes on the real device.

workflow: Read the relevant MCP specification before modifying a feature.
Inspect on the physical device when the change affects platform behavior.
Report deviations instead of silently changing frozen product rules.
do_not: Implement all phases in one uncontrolled pass.
Replace architecture because a shortcut is easier.
Treat passing compilation as proof of payment correctness.
Treat a visually similar screen as proof of correct navigation or payment semantics.
